result.reason: The new ownership provision substantially reaches the playbook position: the Company owns the Site, work product and Company Data; HDI assigns relevant rights, retains pre-existing IP, and grants a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence for embedded HDI materials; and joint ownership is disclaimed. However, the unrelated General Manager paragraph is unnecessary, introduces new operational authority and responsibility, and is a sentence fragment. Its insertion changes unrelated commercial terms and materially reduces drafting quality. The ownership drafting also imprecisely states that HDI assigns “all such rights,” including rights in Company materials HDI may never have owned.
